title: The Turkey Board
trend: TikTok 'Turkey Charcuterie Boards' (sped-up builds of a cheese, cracker and meat board shaped like a turkey, reveal in the last seconds; New Engen TikTok list, updated Nov 13 2026, US) + Friendsgiving / Thanksgiving prep week — Bethany films a step-by-step turkey board tutorial for Friendsgiving while her brother Dwayne keeps eating the cracker feathers and Gerald, the cheese ball, refuses to be a bird; beats: feathers vanish one by one, the pepper beak and pretzel legs, salami roses ('why does meat need to be a flower' / 'why does cheese need to be a bird'), the turkey goes from full to plucked; twist: every friend sends a photo of the exact same turkey board, so seven turkeys and no forks — the plucked one is the only different one and becomes the hit; button: Gerald wants to be a pumpkin next year
length_reason: Turkey board build videos are quick one-clip speed builds (about 30-60 s), so this stays a quick one-clip skit at the shortest film length: 3:00.
youtube_title: She Made A Turkey Out Of Snacks. Her Brother Kept Eating The Feathers | Funny Cartoon
description:
Bethany is making the perfect turkey snack board for Friendsgiving, one step at a time. Her brother Dwayne keeps eating the feathers, and the cheese ball in the middle does not want to be a bird.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #friendsgiving
tiktok_caption: step one of the turkey board: hide it from your brother 🦃 #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #friendsgiving

lines.text: Hi friends! Today we are making a turkey board for Friendsgiving.
Step one. Hide it from Dwayne.
I am right here.
Step two. Crackers in a big fan. These are the feathers.
That one is crooked.
It is not crooked.
It is gone now. So it is not crooked anymore.
Dwayne! That was a feather!
Feathers fall off birds. It is natural.
Step three. The cheese ball goes in the middle. He is the body.
Excuse me.
I am a cheese ball. I am not a bird.
Today you are a bird, Gerald.
I have been rolled in nuts. I have been through enough.
Step four. A little pepper for the beak.
There is a pepper on my face.
It is a beak. It is adorable.
I look like I lost a fight with a salad.
Step five. Pretzel sticks for the legs.
How many legs does a turkey have?
Two.
Then why are there six pretzels on the plate?
Because I know you.
That is fair. That is very fair.
Now, look back at the feathers.
There were twenty feathers. There are fourteen.
I am the official feather tester.
That is not a job.
Quality control. Somebody has to protect our friends.
Step six. Salami roses. You fold the salami into a little flower.
Why does meat need to be a flower?
Why does cheese need to be a bird?
Because it is pretty! Everything on this board is pretty!
I am sweating.
Cheese does not sweat.
This cheese does. The oven has been on since noon.
Step seven. Grapes around the edge, like a little garden.
Can I test one grape?
No.
Can I test half a grape?
There is no half a grape, Dwayne.
Okay. Let us look at our turkey.
There are four feathers.
I am cold. I was a proud bird. Now I am a plucked bird.
It is a turkey after Thanksgiving. That is a whole look.
Our friends come in ten minutes!
Wait. Keisha sent a photo of her board.
It is a turkey. With cracker feathers. And a cheese ball.
Marcus sent one too. Also a turkey.
Tanya. Turkey. Jordan. Turkey. Both Ashleys. Turkey.
So we are going to have seven turkeys and no forks.
Finally. I am among my people.
Seven perfect turkeys. Nobody will even see mine.
Six perfect turkeys.
Ours is the only one that tells a story.
What story?
The turkey ran. The turkey fought. The turkey lost his feathers. The turkey survived.
I did survive. I am a survivor.
Dwayne. That is actually beautiful.
I know. I ate the feathers for art.
Final step. Put a little sign on him. The turkey who made it.
Can it say Gerald?
It can say Gerald.
Can I test one grape now?
No.
And next year, I want to be a pumpkin.
